foundry.name: The Foundry
foundry.desc: Crowded industrial network. +25% regular enemy spawn rate; +20% shard XP. Earn upgrades faster, but leave room to escape.

blackout.name: Blackout
blackout.desc: Distant ordinary enemies are dimmed; shard pickup range −25%. On entry: one trigger + one effect for your code editor. Bosses, elites and attack warnings stay visible.

sanctuary.name: Sanctuary
sanctuary.desc: A quieter repair network. −15% regular enemy spawn rate and repair 0.75 integrity per second; −15% shard XP. A recovery route with slower growth.

auditor.name: Audit Mark
auditor.desc: Every 6 seconds, mark up to 3 nearby enemies for 4 seconds. Marked enemies take 35% more damage.

boss.name: Purge Echo
boss.desc: Every 8 seconds, emit a 160m pulse dealing 28 base damage and pushing enemies away.

collector.name: Shard Siphon
collector.desc: Every 10 seconds, pull all shards within 500m toward you.

mirror.name: Mirror Lance
mirror.desc: Every 7 seconds, strike the nearest enemy within 420m for 45 base damage.

phantom.name: Phase Step
phantom.desc: Every 12 seconds while moving, phase through enemies and firewalls for 1 second. Enemy shots can still hit you.

return.name: Return Protocol
return.desc: Glyph Bolt and Slow Rounds projectiles return once and may hit the same target again. Each pass deals 70% normal damage. Other weapons are unchanged.

mines.name: Orbital Mines
mines.desc: Three proximity mines orbit you. Each detonates for 32 base damage, then re-arms after 6 seconds. Tradeoff: movement speed −8%.

clone.name: Afterimage
clone.desc: Using a power leaves a clone at your old position. After 1 second it blasts a 120m area for 70 base damage. Tradeoff: power cooldowns +20%.

gunslinger.name: Gunslinger
gunslinger.desc: Weapon damage +15%, but power cooldowns +10% and code damage −15%. A specialist in direct fire.

codebreaker.name: Codebreaker
codebreaker.desc: Code damage +25%, but weapon damage −10% and shard pickup range −10%. Receive one trigger/effect kit on selection.

phantom.name: Phantom
phantom.desc: Movement speed +10%, but maximum integrity −10%. Built for evasion and positioning. This reduces current integrity proportionally too.

clean.name: Ghost signal
clean.desc: Survive 30 consecutive seconds without being hit
